name: Confusion
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create delusions in creatures' minds, provoking unpredictable behavior. Choose a point within long range. Roll Insight vs Awareness against each creature within short range of that point. Your roll result becomes the Difficulty.

On each win, the creature cannot use reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn:

1

The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction and its actions are reduced to 0 this turn.

2-6

The creature's Speed and actions are both reduced to 0 this turn.

7-8

The creature must spend an action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.

9-10

The creature can act and move normally.

At the end of each of its turns, the creature may roll Riddle against the Difficulty to attempt to end the effect.

Describe the delusions you create.
successes:
✨: On each win, each of the creature's d10 rolls to determine its behavior are ill-favored. On each loss, the creature checks a Condition.

🌞: On each loss, the creature is affected as on a win for 1 round, then the effect ends.
